writeup: The Hexago 5000 CFM evaporative swamp cooler (model HI-COOL-13GDIGIT-MIST-1P, UPC 810058283603) is new on Woot for $169.99. It has a 13.2-gallon tank, a mist function, a remote, a 15-hour timer, and is rated to cover about 950 square feet. Tornado Fans has the same unit in stock at $649.98, so this is 73% and about $480 below that current price. Woot showed only 2 left, with a limit of 10 per customer.
